main.description: Posts and reposts, newest first, by accounts this AppView serves for a listed community that the caller follows: top-level posts, replies to accounts the caller follows, and reposts; and reposts of their posts by the caller and by accounts the caller follows (reason app.bsky.feed.defs#reasonRepost). For a member, from its stored follows; empty for anyone else.

servedAs.description: The form this answer was served in: `member` (a ready member, with its stored viewer state) or `visitor` (anyone else).
